summary: Main-process workspace-bar service: tracks windows, persists pinned entries, single-frame window switching, IPC channel
notes: Promoted on commit 82bf6e0: 28 electron-main service tests pass in 1.41 s (' 28 passing (27ms)'). In the running app the main process sampled the visible window set every 1 ms across two switches (about 6100 samples): the visible set was exactly one window at every sample, the bounds were identical, and both renderers stayed alive; relaunching with three windows restored exactly one visible window. 19 hand mutations of the service, 17 killed, the 2 survivors redundant guards. Two real failures were fixed on the way and are recorded as trials 1 and 2 under this node: an ordinary window close never reached the service because upstream's onDidDestroyWindow fires only for crashed windows (now a per-window onDidClose, with test doubles that mirror upstream's real event ordering), and a takeover through another window's own show left two windows visible for about 200 ms because macOS reports show about 200 ms late (focus is now a takeover trigger too, overlap about 16 ms). [OPEN] native fullscreen, the missing-folder modal, remote hosts and non-macOS maximize are not smoke-tested. [OPEN] a quit veto raised with a custom dialog style from a hidden window needs a renderer hook.
